subject: Readiness tabletop + evidence routes for ISO/FedRAMP
messages:
From: Jane Sato <jane.sato@nimbus-fin.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: security@nimbus-fin.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: tabletop on ISO->FedRAMP evidence flow + snapshot window

Kimberly / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Nimbus is preparing a combined ISO 27001 readiness assessment and a FedRAMP Low intake; our security operations team would like to run a short tabletop to validate the evidence routing and sampling decisions before we start the intake. High level asks: 

- Confirm which artifacts Redwood can produce from the platform (system config snapshots, audit logs, snapshot retention periods, KMS attestation).
- Define a short mutual action plan (owners + dates) for SIG/CAIQ overlap so we don't duplicate work.
- Identify a 48-hour snapshot window where auditors can extract logs/snapshots for sampling.

Can we run a 60-minute tabletop this week? Our preferred windows are Tue/Wed morning PST. Also attaching a quick column of questions from our compliance team.

Thanks,

Jane Sato
Head of InfoSec Programs
Nimbus Financial
attachments: tabletop-questions-v1.pdf (pdf stub)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Jane Sato <jane.sato@nimbus-fin.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: tabletop on ISO->FedRAMP evidence flow + snapshot window

Jane — thanks for the notes and the attached questions. We can absolutely run a focused tabletop and map artifacts to both ISO and FedRAMP asks so you get a single evidence stream. Proposed plan: 

1) 60-minute tabletop (agenda attached) — we cover scope, evidence producers, snapshot windows, and a sample extraction walkthrough.
2) Post-tabletop: Redwood will deliver an evidence inventory CSV (we'll attach a first snapshot) and a short control narrative template for the controls that typically overlap between SIG/CAIQ/ISO.
3) Owners: assign system artifacts to Aditya (logs & snapshots), Olga (control narratives, config export), Marissa (comms + artifact handoff).

Possible slots (PST): Tue 10/13 09:30 or Wed 10/14 08:30. Which works for your auditors? 48-hour snapshot window we can schedule for Mon 10/19 00:00 - Tue 10/20 23:59 PST (we can narrow once you confirm the extraction timing).

I've attached the tabletop agenda (tabletop-agenda-v1.docx) and a preliminary evidence_inventory_snapshot.csv. We should also confirm the KMS attestation owner and whether Nimbus needs HSM details or just key rotation proof.

Next steps: pick a slot and I'll set up the calendar + share the Drive folder link where we'll stage artifacts.

—Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192
attachments: tabletop-agenda-v1.docx, evidence_inventory_snapshot.csv
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: tabletop on ISO->FedRAMP evidence flow + snapshot window

Team — quick operational notes to bring to the tabletop: 

- Log retention: application logs (30 days by default, can export snapshots on demand), API access logs (90 days), KV-cache / runtime telemetry (14 days). We can generate a point-in-time export for the 48-hour window and provide checksums.
- Snapshot mechanics: we create a read-only snapshot of the serving fleet and control-plane metadata; extraction will be via an S3 pre-signed endpoint in your auditor account or we can push into a secured Drive. For FedRAMP Low, auditors usually want both config and request/response headers — avoid PII by redaction, which we can automate for the export.
- KMS: we can provide a KMS rotation history and a signed attest that keys are customer-metadata only. HSM-level attestations require a separate compliance package (Olga to advise).

Action items for the tabletop: confirm extraction method (S3 vs Drive), redaction rules, and if auditors need live access vs archived snapshot. I'll prep the extraction checklist and a short runbook.

—Aditya Rao
Staff Engineer, Runtime & Observability
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@auditorsuite.com>
To: Jane Sato <jane.sato@nimbus-fin.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: security@nimbus-fin.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: tabletop on ISO->FedRAMP evidence flow + snapshot window

Kimberly / Jane — thanks, that plan looks reasonable. A few clarifications from the auditor side before the tabletop: 

- Scope: we'll operate to FedRAMP Low baseline controls and map those to ISO 27001 Annex A where requested. Expect a 2-3 day sampling window after the snapshot for follow-up questions.
- Evidence formats: prefer S3 pre-signed links to reduce transfer issues, but a secured Drive folder is acceptable if it meets immutable snapshot criteria.
- Redaction: provide a redaction policy (list of fields) and a short hash manifest so we can verify integrity.

I'll join the Wed 10/14 08:30 PST slot — please send calendar invite and the Drive/S3 link post-invite. We'll run a brief dry-run during the tabletop and schedule the actual snapshot for 10/19 as proposed. 

DocuSign / LOA: I can circulate a standard LOA for auditor access; if Nimbus prefers, I can send it after the tabletop.

Tom Reed
Senior Engagement Manager
AuditorSuite LLC
